paite: Hiai Adam suante tuan na laibu ahi. Pathianin mi a siam niin Pathian batpihin amah a bawla;
english: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, he made him in God’s likeness.

paite: Pasal leh numeiin amau a siama; amau a vualzawla, a min uh Adam, a chi, amau siama a om ni un
english: He created them male and female, and blessed them, and called their name “Adam,” “Adam” and “Man” are spelled with the exact same consonants in Hebrew, so this can be correctly translated either way. in the day when they were created.

paite: Huan, Adamin, kum ja leh kum sawmthum ahihin, amah bang mahmah, amah kibatpih ngei tapa a neia; a min din Seth a sa hi;
english: Adam lived one hundred thirty years, and became the father of a son in his own likeness, after his image, and named him Seth.

paite: Huan, Seth a neih nungin Adam kum za giat a dam laia: tanu leh tapate a nei nawn lai hi.
english: The days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years, and he became the father of sons and daughters.

paite: Huchiin, Adam dam sung tengteng kum za kua leh kum sawm thum ahia; huan a sita hi.
english: All the days that Adam lived were nine hundred thirty years, then he died.

paite: Huan, Sethin, kum ja leh kum nga ahihin, tapa Enosa a neia:
english: Seth lived one hundred five years, and became the father of Enosh.

paite: Huan, Enosa a neih nungin Seth kum za giat leh kum sagih a dam laia, tanu leh tapate a nei nawn lai hi:
english: Seth lived after he became the father of Enosh eight hundred seven years, and became the father of sons and daughters.

paite: Huchiin, Seth dam sung tengteng kum za kua leh kum sawm leh kum nih ahia; huan, a sita hi.
english: All the days of Seth were nine hundred twelve years, then he died.

paite: Huan, Enosain, kum sawm kua ahihih, tapa Kenan a neia:
english: Enosh lived ninety years, and became the father of Kenan.

paite: Huan, Kenan a neih nungin Enosa kum za giat leh kum sawm leh kum nga a dam laia, tanu leh tapate a nei nawn laia:
english: Enosh lived after he became the father of Kenan, eight hundred fifteen years, and became the father of sons and daughters.

paite: Huchiin, Enosa dam sung tengteng kum za kua kum nga ahi a: a sita hi.
english: All the days of Enosh were nine hundred five years, then he died.

paite: Huan, Kenanin, kum sawm sagih ahihin, tapa Mahalalel a neita:
english: Kenan lived seventy years, and became the father of Mahalalel.

paite: Huan, Mahalalel a neih nungin Kenan kum za giat leh kum li a dam laia, tanu leh tapate a nei nawn lai hi:
english: Kenan lived after he became the father of Mahalalel eight hundred forty years, and became the father of sons and daughters

paite: Huchiin, Kenan dam sung tengteng kum za kua leh kum sawm ahia: huan, a sita hi.
english: and all the days of Kenan were nine hundred ten years, then he died.

paite: Huan, Mahalalel, kum sawm guk leh kum nga ahihin, tapa Jared a neia:
english: Mahalalel lived sixty-five years, and became the father of Jared.

paite: Huan, Jared a neih nungin Mahalalel kum za giat leh kum sawm thum a dam laia, tanu leh tapate a nei nawn laia:
english: Mahalalel lived after he became the father of Jared eight hundred thirty years, and became the father of sons and daughters.

paite: Huchiin, Mahalalel dam sung tengteng kum za giat leh kum sawm kua leh kum nga ahia: huan, a sita hi.
english: All the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred ninety-five years, then he died.

paite: Huan, Jared in, kum ja leh kum sawm guk leh kum nih a hihin, tapa Enok a neia:
english: Jared lived one hundred sixty-two years, and became the father of Enoch.

paite: Huan, Enok a neih nungin Jared kum za giat a dam laia, tanu leh tapate a nei nawn laia:
english: Jared lived after he became the father of Enoch eight hundred years, and became the father of sons and daughters.

paite: Huchiin, Jared dam sung tengteng kum za kua leh kum sawm guk leh kum nih ahi: huan a sita hi.
english: All the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty-two years, then he died.

paite: Huan, Enokin, kum sawm guk leh kum nga a hihin, tapa Methusel a neia:
english: Enoch lived sixty-five years, and became the father of Methuselah.

paite: Huan, Methusel a neih nungin Enok kum za thum sung teng Pathian toh a omkhawm ua, tanu leh tapate a nein awn laia:
english: Enoch walked with God after he became the father of Methuselah three hundred years, and became the father of sons and daughters.

paite: Huan, Enok dam sung tengteng kum za thum leh kum sawm guk leh kum nga ahia:
english: All the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty-five years.

paite: Huan, Enok Pathian toh a om khawm ua: huan a omta keia; Pathianin a la mang ta ahi.
english: Enoch walked with God, and he was not, for God took him.

paite: Huan, Methusel, kum ja leh kum sawm giat leh kum sagih a hihin, tapa Lamek a neia:
english: Methuselah lived one hundred eighty-seven years, and became the father of Lamech.

paite: Huan, Lamek a neih nungin Methusel kum za sagih leh kum sawm giat leh kum nih a dam laia, tanu leh tapate a nei nawn laia:
english: Methuselah lived after he became the father of Lamech seven hundred eighty-two years, and became the father of sons and daughters.

paite: Huchiin Methusel dam sung tengteng kum za kua leh kum sawm guk leh kum kua ahia: huan, a sita hi.
english: All the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty-nine years, then he died.

paite: Huan, Lamekin, kum ja leh kum sawm giat leh kum nih a hihin tapa a neia:
english: Lamech lived one hundred eighty-two years, and became the father of a son,

paite: Huan, hiai ngeingeiin Toupa hamsiat khum leitung jiaka a nasepna leh khuta I sepgimnaah honlungmuan ding, chiin, a min din Noa a sa hi.
english: and he named him Noah, saying, “This same will comfort us in our work and in the toil of our hands, because of the ground which Yahweh has cursed.”

paite: Huan, Noa a neih nungin Lamek kum nga leh kum sawm kua leh kum nga a dam laia, tanu leh tapate a nein awn laia:
english: Lamech lived after he became the father of Noah five hundred ninety-five years, and became the father of sons and daughters.

paite: Huan, Lamek dam sung tengteng kum za sagih leh kum sawm sagih leh kum sagih ahia; huan a sita hi.Huan, Noa kum za ngaa a upa ahi: Noain tapa Sem te Ham te leh Japheth te a nei.
english: All the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy-seven years, then he died.

paite: Huan, Noa kum za ngaa a upa ahi: Noain tapa Sem te Ham te leh Japheth te a nei.
english: Noah was five hundred years old, and Noah became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
